name: codebase-memory
description: Query a code graph through the codebase-memory-mcp server, skill, and graph-verification agents.

interface.shortDescription: Code-graph MCP tools, skill, and agents for Claude Code and Copilot CLI.
interface.longDescription: Registers the codebase-memory-mcp server and ships upstream's codebase-memory skill, its scout, verify, and auditor agents, and its hooks. A session-start and subagent-start hook injects the graph-first instructions and any graph context into the session and every subagent. Needs the codebase-memory-mcp binary on PATH. Claude Code and Copilot CLI only for now.
